questions.q: For the model $f(x) = 6x + 4$ in inverse functions (extended), evaluate $f(2)$.
Find the positive solutions to the quadratic equation $x^2 - 5x + 4 = 0$.
A data set recorded for inverse functions (extended) consists of the four values $\{17, 21, 25, 31\}$. What is the arithmetic mean?
questions.answer: The sum is $17 + 21 + 25 + 31 = 94$, and dividing by $4$ gives $23.5$.
